# Hex

> Hex is free, open-source voice dictation and no-bot meeting transcription for Mac, Windows, and Linux. Hold a shortcut, speak, and a local Parakeet or Whisper model types what you said into whatever app has the cursor. Audio never leaves the machine, and dictation keeps working offline after a one-time model download. Hex Meetings records the microphone and system audio itself, so no bot joins the call, and `hex mcp` serves the transcripts and notes to AI coding agents, read-only.

- Author: Anomaly (https://anoma.ly)
- Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/hex (MIT)
- Price: free. No account, no subscription, no word limit
- Runs: macOS 15 or later on Apple silicon; Windows 10 and 11 beta (x64 and ARM64); Linux beta (x86_64 and aarch64); iOS 18 or later; Android 12 or later (Hex Preview)
- Privacy: dictation audio, meeting audio, transcripts, and history stay on the machine. No account, no cloud transcription, no telemetry in the app
- Offline: download a model once, then dictation and meeting transcription work with no network

## Get Hex

- Mac: https://anoma.ly/hex/download/macos-arm64-dmg, or `brew install --cask anomalyco/tap/hex`
- Windows beta: https://anoma.ly/hex/download/windows-x64-setup (ARM64: https://anoma.ly/hex/download/windows-arm64-setup)
- Linux beta: `curl -fsSL https://anoma.ly/hex/install-linux.sh | sh`; packages and binaries at https://anoma.ly/hex
- iPhone: https://anoma.ly/hex/iphone · Android: https://anoma.ly/hex/android
- Every release, with notes: https://anoma.ly/hex/changelog

- [Hex for iPhone](https://anoma.ly/hex/iphone): the keyboard, App Store link, and FAQ

- [Hex Labs](https://anoma.ly/hex/labs): features Hex is trying out, each off until it is turned on

- [Dev builds](https://anoma.ly/hex/dev): notes for each dev build

## Docs

- [Transforms](https://anoma.ly/hex/docs/transforms.md): JavaScript and TypeScript in `~/.config/hex/hex.config.ts` that rewrites dictated text before it is pasted
- [Managed settings](https://anoma.ly/hex/docs/admin.md): macOS configuration-profile keys that turn Meetings, Annotate, OpenCode processing, transforms, Labs, and updates off
- [CLI and transcripts](https://github.com/anomalyco/hex/blob/dev/docs/transcript-cli.md): `hex history`, `hex meetings list|show|chapters|search`, and `hex mcp --meetings-dir`
- [Control CLI](https://github.com/anomalyco/hex/blob/dev/docs/cli.md): status, dictation, settings, models, and the local API
- [Windows](https://github.com/anomalyco/hex/blob/dev/docs/windows.md) and [Linux](https://github.com/anomalyco/hex/blob/dev/docs/linux.md): each beta's setup and limits
- [TypeScript SDK](https://github.com/anomalyco/hex/blob/dev/sdk/typescript/README.md): `@kitlangton/hex` for local transcription in another app

## For agents

- [llms-full.txt](https://anoma.ly/hex/llms-full.txt): the whole reference in one Markdown file
- [skill.md](https://anoma.ly/hex/skill.md): how an agent installs Hex and reads it with the CLI and MCP
- `hex mcp`: read-only MCP server over stdio for meeting transcripts, search, chapters, and stored notes. Tools: `list_meetings`, `search_transcripts`, `get_transcript`, `get_meeting_notes`, `get_chapters`; resource `hex-meeting://<meeting_id>`
- `hex history`, `hex meetings`, and `hex mcp` read files and never start Hex; only `hex start` and `hex restart` launch it

## What Hex does

- Local dictation on macOS, Windows, and Linux, with Parakeet and Whisper GGUF models, Apple Speech on the Mac, and custom models
- No-bot meeting transcription on the Mac: microphone plus system audio, live chapters, a stored summary, search, SRT and VTT export, and configurable retention
- Annotate: capture a screen, a window, a region, or a connected iPhone and open it in an OpenCode session
- Transforms: deterministic JavaScript for the text Hex pastes, including `fetch` and `node:child_process` after you approve the config's exact contents
- A command line for status, dictation, settings, history, meetings, and transcribing a file
- Labs: unproven features, off by default, turned on in Settings › Labs or with `hex labs on <id>`

## What Hex does not do

- No bot joins a call, and Hex cannot transcribe a meeting it did not record
- No cloud transcription, account, subscription, word cap, or per-minute billing
- Meeting capture runs on the Mac today; Windows and Linux run dictation, the CLI, and the read-only MCP server
- Remote speakers are not separated: the microphone is "You" and system audio is "Them"
